items.reason: 25 database functions are called from this area, all open to the not-signed-in app role (live catalog). 21 take the member key: a 192-bit random key, stored hashed; every read and write is cut to that member or that member's gym (orders by member, products by gym, cancel only own order). staff_sign_out takes a staff session key. gym_preview and member_join take the gym's join code, which can be guessed with no try limit (already FN-L3-server-database-1-01). member_find_gyms and member_claim_phone need a one-time WhatsApp number proof, and a claim only matches the member's own gym list. staff_sign_in takes mobile and PIN with the server's tries and locks (its door is switched off in this app). member_gym_pack is not in the live catalog (its file says it was never applied), so the app falls back. Web routes: three payment routes take the member key and the server checks gym and member (no cross-member test: FN-L3-server-panel-worker-03); the number check start and lead form take no key by design; the number check status uses a random id and hands the proof out once.

Apps-cannot-read variant: the phone code in this area reads no table directly, only through functions. Live catalog: row rules on for every table; the 10 rules that exist belong to signed-in panel users or picture storage, and none lets the not-signed-in app role read a gym table (security.sql reads every table as that role and expects nothing; its thin seed is FN-L3-server-hq-gate-workers-04). Through the functions, a test proves another gym or member is refused for: shop products (gym B shop and gym B product), shop orders (another member's order, read and cancel), messages and message-seen (gym B message), check-in (gym B code), plan requests (gym B member cannot mark or cancel), report requests (gym B member sees none, cannot answer), membership records (gym B member sees none), trainer questions (gym B trainer and owner refused), number claim (number not on this gym's list refused). Bring-a-friend invites and referrals: read only by the member's own key, no other-gym test (L3.3).

Two gaps, both already written: the Bring a friend invite and referral tables have no test with a second gym (the member side here reads them by the member key only; the owner side gap is FN-L3-panel-screens-1-01, same tables, same fix); sending the workout report is never tried with another gym's member key, only answering is (FN-L3-phone-shop-2-01). Every other table this area reaches has a refusal test (L3.2).
Rule applied: no live cross-gym attempt was run; only code, catalog and the existing database tests were read.

No key pattern hit in this area (items list and secrets list); the only addresses in code are MettleUp's own public web addresses. The member key is held in app state and sent only to MettleUp, never logged.
No outside-service key in this area: payments, the WhatsApp number check and the lead form all go through MettleUp's own server, which holds the keys; the app sends only the member key.

Staff sign-in from the member app is switched off; when on it hides the PIN, uses the server's wrong-PIN lock, and ends the staff session at once. That lock counts by network address, which our own server address shares for everyone (FN-L3-server-panel-worker-01). The member key does not expire by time (a device key); leaving the gym replaces it. Check-in tries are limited per member per minute. No PIN reset in this area.

Every text box (name, mobile, PIN, messages and questions to the gym) goes to the server as a named value of a database function or a JSON body, never pasted into a query; the WhatsApp link escapes its text; names are cut to 60 characters on the server; the app draws text as plain text, and opens only https payment pages and upi links.

The only upload is the workout report text the member agrees to send: the server refuses it before the member said yes, a wrong file, or more than 3,000,000 characters (tests cover each). No pictures are uploaded here.

Join links (/j/code) and check-in links (/c/code) carry the gym's 6-character join code, which can be found by trying codes (FN-L3-server-database-1-01); a check-in link also needs the member's own key and refuses another gym's code. Bring-a-friend links use an 8-character random code (about 34 billion choices). Joining from a link needs the member to tick the terms and press Join.

This area uses the screen-navigation library for every screen and for the join and check-in links; it is flagged high through a link-decoding part (FN-L3-phone-tracker-components-1-02). The phone spreadsheet library 0.18.5 with two high alerts is not used in this area but ships in the same app (FN-L3-phone-tracker-components-1-01). The other libraries used here (camera, picture, storage, QR) have no alert. Automatic dependency alerts are off (FN-L3-server-ci-workflows-02).
